name: create-kestrel
description: Scaffold a Kestrel site: `pnpm create kestrel my-site`.
author: Michael Thielemann <283621694+MichaelThielemann@users.noreply.github.com>
//payload: `templates` and `lib` are NOT in git — `prepack` copies them from the engine at the repo root so there is exactly one source and drift is impossible, and `postpack` removes them again. From a checkout the bin falls back to the engine's own paths, so it runs without packing. `version` must be bumped together with the engine's: release.yml's tag guard reads only the root manifest, and prepack CANNOT fix a mismatch because npm reads this manifest before running it. test/create-kestrel.test.ts pins the two equal, and prepack refuses to pack a mismatch.
